doc: Stock display names, keyed by stock slug (the source holding key, lowercased, non-alphanumerics to '-'). renames: verified company renames (name now, formerly then), each with a source. display: cleaner spelling of the same company where the only source name is a raw registry string. Used by scripts/research-pages.mjs and the app.

zomato-ltd.name: Eternal Ltd
zomato-ltd.source: Ministry of Corporate Affairs approved Zomato Ltd -> Eternal Ltd on 20 Mar 2025

shriram-transport-finance-company-ltd.name: Shriram Finance Ltd
shriram-transport-finance-company-ltd.source: Renamed Dec 2022 after the Shriram City Union merger; same ISIN INE721A01013

dewan-housing-finance-corporation-ltd.name: Piramal Finance Ltd
dewan-housing-finance-corporation-ltd.source: DHFL, acquired by Piramal in 2021, became Piramal Finance Ltd and relisted (NSE: PIRAMALFIN, BSE: 544597); https://groww.in/stocks/dewan-housing-finance-corporation-ltd shows Piramal Finance Ltd

aadhar-housing-finance-ltd.name: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd
aadhar-housing-finance-ltd.source: DHFL Vysya Housing Finance was renamed Aadhar Housing Finance in 2017; the source key is the new name
